at_sea: Interactive verdict session over the enriched rulings file (CairnCommons/rulings-for-akien-2026-08-22.txt). 12 findings verdicted across design/idea/intent categories and scraped from the working list — 241 remain (design 0, idea 35, intent 58, saveslate 64, sorted 81, whatslefttodo 3). Design section fully cleared. Along the way, several design decisions were made and captured: (1) universal addressing and bidirectional links promoted from idea to intention (CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-universal-addressing-and-bidirectional-links.md); (2) gate broadcast architecture — one probe per gate on the bus's public channel, shims subscribe, replacing per-watcher probes; (3) banding bands renamed to preprocess/record/postprocess; (4) trouble device folds into the cairn device ('the utility closet in the datacenter, but also the control room'); (5) BaseDevice is for internal devices only — CC and Calibre would not subclass it. Project named 'Cognition Apparatus for Investigation of Reasoning Networks' (Akien's choice) — added to README and all 8 press office documents, committed and pushed both repos.
next_direction: Continue the interactive verdict review. Next section is idea (35 findings), starting at 6de04cb5c970 (the sleep trigger).
